summary: Grindr Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting the settlement of a UK group action alleging violations of UK privacy laws related to historical data practices before 2020, when it was owned by Kunlun. The settlement includes no admission of liability. Grindr agreed to pay £13.0 million by December 31, 2026, and another £13.0 million by March 31, 2027, equivalent to approximately $17.6 million each using the September 3, 2026 exchange rate. The filing is an ordinary litigation update, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are involved. What to watch: timing of settlement payments and any subsequent disclosures.
